tips.frostedheart.scenario_tip.title: Tips
tips.frostedheart.scenario_tip.desc3: Press &6[ESC]&r five times to skip cinematic
tips.frostedheart.sensible_temperature.d: The orb at the bottom of your screen displays your &6Sensible Temperature&r, which reflects whether you feel &b&lcold&r or &6&lhot&r in the current environment.

Note that &6Sensible Temperature &lis NOT&r &6Body Temperature&r, but rather a calculation result combining factors like ambient temperature, body heat, and clothing. The most comfortable sensible temperature is human body temperature, which is 37°C (98.6°F).
tips.frostedheart.murderer.title: Murderer
tips.frostedheart.murderer.desc1: You killed a non-hostile human being. Clearly, this won't do any good to your relationship with them.
tips.frostedheart.murderer.desc3: If you continue doing this, they might refuse to trade or communicate with you.
tips.frostedheart.maniac.title: Maniac
tips.frostedheart.fertilizer.title: Fertilizer
tips.frostedheart.fertilizer.desc1: There are three types of fertilizer: Growth Acceleration, Yield Booster, and Preserved. Each type comes in three tiers: Basic, Advanced, and Modern.
tips.frostedheart.fertilizer.desc2: Right-click on soil or crops to apply fertilizer. Crops will gain corresponding beneficial effects.
tips.frostedheart.fertilizer.desc3: A single soil block can hold up to two applications of the same fertilizer.
tips.frostedheart.fertilizer.desc4: Hold the {item.frostedheart.soil_thermometer} to view detailed crop information.
